summary: SpaceNav es un observatorio web avanzado que permite a los usuarios explorar datos de cielo abierto de la NASA, comparar archivos de múltiples épocas y rastrear objetos celestes en movimiento en tiempo real: https://space-nav.vercel.app
details:
SpaceNav transforms raw astronomical data into an accessible, high-performance exploration tool inspired by aerospace-grade command centers (SpaceX-style user interface). It bridges the gap between complex NASA telescope archives and those of collaborators, allowing users to easily search for coordinates, explore celestial points of interest, and detect moving candidates (such as asteroids, high proper motion stars, and brown dwarfs).

How it works
Built with React, TypeScript, and a hybrid architecture, SpaceNav connects in real time to NASA's SkyView Virtual Observatory API to obtain multiband astronomical plate swatches (DSS1, DSS2, 2MASS, WISE).

It includes a multi-epoch ghost overlay (cyan/magenta mix and difference) to reveal temporal changes, an interactive astrometric vector analyzer that calculates angular separation and proper motion, an edge drift warning system to track objects near the frame boundary, and an automated report generator formatted to Minor Planet Center (MPC)/NASA standards.

It also includes an offline security mode with pre-loaded caching for flawless live presentations.

Impact
By democratizing deep space exploration and providing professional-grade telemetry tools to the public, SpaceNav turns many more people into active contributors to space science and asteroid discovery.

Explore the interactive web app live.
